steps.content: Less than a year after BR-003's emergence, the first large-scale conflict broke out. Fortunately, the defenders held their ground. Once stability was achieved through dimensional analyses, the Black Ring was once again concealed.
DisCity's skies are as azure as ever, and history continues to march on.
Yet somewhere beyond everyone's sight, some may remain trapped in the same place forever.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: Professor Celine was already severely wounded when she was found. Numerous Mania creatures infiltrated the library, and that night she was there alone... She doesn't remember anything now.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: Her special power is the Maniafication of memories. All the memories she retains due to her hyperthymesia, all the information she's ever absorbed, can be converted into power, which will be consumed if she wields it. There were too many monsters that night. She exhausted everything, and still she couldn't save the library.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: ...Why? Why did the enemy target her? What truth was destroyed? Why did she evacuate the library and stay there alone... Did she know it was coming?

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: And what's the point? She gave it her all, and still couldn't save anything...

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: It's all my fault... If I hadn't said those things that day, if I'd stayed with her... Those were what she treasured most...

steps.speaker: Linda
steps.content: Can she still be cured...? Is there anything I can do for her?
[Transition 1s]

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What? The library got burned down overnight? What the hell... I finally found a place that made reading more tolerable...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: That lady with the super long hair seems really trustworthy. Does that mean she can move into the Bureau now? I really enjoyed the lessons she gave me!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: When's she coming?
[Transition 1s]

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief...
You step into the hospital room and see... a familiar sight.

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: "Time stops for no soul, as the river will not linger."

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: "And when you wake, the fleeting light of bygone days drifts away like a dream..."

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: Hello. Are you my friend too?

steps.speaker: Celine
steps.content: Then please tell me something about the past. This time... I'll remember it properly.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...This can't be real.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What happened? How did this happen?! Aren't you a chronicler? The one who records history?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Then why is it that when it comes to your own story...

PixelReborn:
Ta-da! I'M BACK! Did you all miss me? Well, never mind that. Let's get straight to the latest juicy scandals!

PixelReborn:
So! The DisCity Central Library, you know, the great library we all know, was suddenly burned to the ground! The entire collection has been locked away, and they've sealed all the library system records! Not a single detail about the scene has been made public!

PixelReborn:
Professor Celine, the Head Librarian and head of United U's College of Humanities, is on "honorary medical leave," with no word on when she'll be back. Convenient timing, huh?

PixelReborn:
So what exactly happened there? Ahem... Oh, it's sooo hard to guess... I'm sure it has absolutely nothing to do with Mania or anything like that, right? Hehe.

PixelReborn:
Oh, I almost forgot the gossip about the science peeps! Isomer, Director of the Ring Research Institute, has gone missing, and the Institute refuses to comment on it. Oof, what a shame for all those research projects and industry partnerships. Looks like they're all down the drain now!

PixelReborn:
Lambert? Heh... that old geezer's still scrubbing the academy's toilets. Guess he's too busy and too wimpy to even glance at the Director's seat now.

PixelReborn:
Why are people still  DMing me what happened? Didn't you see the Black Ring overhead? Sheesh... United U students aren't just bad at papers. They're blind too.

PixelReborn:
But hey, no worries! As long as you've got cash, Pixel can make anything happen for you!

PixelReborn:
Me?

PixelReborn:
Aww, do y'all miss me so much?

PixelReborn:
How could I possibly leave you guys?! I absolutely adore you guys!

PixelReborn:
Don't forget I'm still taking commissions! I've got so many orders—papers, exams, experiments... They keep flooding in! With all these jobs and endless money to make, why would I EVER leave?!

[Scene Change]

With Lemma's technical support, the MBCC tracks down the physical location of the Sillage Society's pool club and raids it. However, every traceable suspect turns out to be suffering from some kind of memory loss, and no valuable intelligence can be extracted from the evidence seized.

While you're occupied with BR-003, Daniel Horston is found dead unexpectedly despite having been placed under witness protection. You and the 9th Agency conduct multiple rounds of investigation into the cause of his death, but still fail to uncover the truth. All you can do is continue broadening the range of investigation.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-02:</color> During the last conflict, we made some interesting discoveries.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-02:</color> The prevailing theory has been that the Underground remains untraceable because their Mania dimension technology far surpasses that of EDGE. This is a fair hypothesis. After all, they would need technology of that caliber to conceal the location of their base and the size of their population.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-02:</color> However, we made an unexpected observation during the recent invasion.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-02:</color> We analyzed the traces left by the Underground's fissures at the site and discovered that their technology is, in essence, a derivative of our own. It was most likely developed from research materials stolen by the traitor Isomer. She truly is a genius in this field.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-02:</color> Conversely, even during the height of the battle, the Underground never deployed any dimension technology demonstrably superior to our own. Instead, they relied on Isomer's insider knowledge to mislead and disrupt our operations, buying themselves time.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-02:</color> Which makes the situation... very intriguing...

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-02:</color> Perhaps they were purposely concealing their true capabilities, willing to endure enormous losses rather than reveal them to us.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-02:</color> Or perhaps... that substantial technological gap never existed at all. They spied on our research progress through Isomer and deployed comparable dimension technology in attacks to reinforce our assumptions, making us believe that dimension technology is the key. But what if this was all just a <color=#fb9259>misdirection</color>?
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-02:</color> They've led us to the conclusion that the Underground conceals itself with dimension technology, tricking us into pouring our resources into the wrong areas, all to mask the true nature of their existence.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-02:</color> What's your take, 07? After all, it was all thanks to you that we made this discovery.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07:</color> ...
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07:</color> It's all mere conjecture for now. I need to gather more data before we can verify our assumption. It will take time. The MBCC will support me as we further investigate the Sillage Society. We'll get to the bottom of this.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07:</color> However... one thing is certain.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07:</color> If dimension technology was really just a misdirection tactic from them, then... we've been deceived for far too long. Which means, we may already be far behind on the real battlefield.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Me? I can handle it.
Lemma gently puts the book she's clutching on the desk. When Celine wakes and sees this new edition of DisCity's Golden Age of Science, perhaps she may remember something.

Now that the Chief Scientist has returned to her own lab, she has taken on the tasks of repairing the damage of BR-003 and solving issues caused by inadequate staff. She has even requested to take over the "Heterogeneous Trial." Apparently, the higher-ups have approved.
Given the current situation, she often has to borrow Summer from you, let alone spare the time to help out at the MBCC. The two of you can only catch up from time to time.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: The search-and-rescue operations are still ongoing. I trust you and the 9th Agency, and I have everyone here with me too. The evaluation has exposed quite a few suspicious details. The Underground must still be hiding something. I need to keep a closer eye on them, which means you and I will be working even more closely.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: ...I said I'd set an example, so I need to follow through and do what I'm supposed to do. I have to show her.
[The 9th Agency, Maximum Security Cell]
Back in the "sickroom," Adelaide receives an unexpected visitor.

steps.speaker: Visitor
steps.content: Those injuries look pretty bad. Just got grilled by someone?

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: No, these are old. They're taking some time to heal, but it's fine. Don't worry about it.
He looks toward the visitor. It's a face that feels both strange and familiar to him.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: After all these years... I'm truly glad that you're willing to come see me.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Did those DisCity agents send you? Unfortunately, if you're here to ask about the whereabouts of the Underground's higher-ups, even I no longer know where they are.
The visitor shakes her head and speaks sincerely.

steps.speaker: Visitor
steps.content: Heh, no one sent me. I came because I wanted to.

steps.speaker: Visitor
steps.content: I met with one of your "friends" in this city... She's interesting enough, but unfortunately, she refused to say more about you. So I had no choice but to come talk to you in person.

steps.speaker: Visitor
steps.content: How did you end up here? Who did you reach out to back then? And... who gave you this special power? Where is she now? Come on, tell me about... that Shepherd from the Underground.
With this, the visitor takes Adelaide's hand and gently brushes over the red mark. She can't hold back her smile any longer.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: You know, I worry about you sometimes... dear brother.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You fought so hard to reach the top, but what is it that you really want?

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: ...What do I want?

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: I'm... never satisfied, always dreaming of things... that will never belong to me.
[Small CG - Maverick]

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: ...True geniuses fear neither the limits of their talent nor the sordid games others play.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: Even when they're oppressed or exploited, when all calculations lead nowhere, when every experiment proves futile, when they're discouraged by hardships... they still press forward. They pursue it as though it were a faith—almost blindly.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: True geniuses are capable of that...

steps.speaker: Echo in the Dream
steps.content: Over here! Geez...Where'd you run off to?

steps.speaker: Echo in the Dream
steps.content: Director... You're late!

steps.speaker: Echo in the Dream
steps.content: Look, I worked out the answer first! What about you?

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: She did it.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: But I can't...

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: I lost sight of the truth long ago...

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: I'm just a mediocre fool, trapped by my own obsessions...
